summary: Enhance your skills in public sector procurement with our 5-day course on laws, policies, and practices. Register now for expert-led training.
lede: Public sector procurement training equips procurement officers and contract managers to plan sourcing, assess bids, and oversee supplier contracts. It covers market analysis, tender design and evaluation, conflict-of-interest controls, and audit-ready recordkeeping. Practical exercises include building procurement plans, evaluation matrices, and supplier performance scorecards to support transparent decisions and public value.
audienceIntro: This public procurement training suits professionals who already work with public buying, tender governance, supplier oversight, or assurance and need deeper operational judgment across the procurement lifecycle.
modules: Public Procurement Law and Policy Foundations
prerequisites: You should have working experience in public procurement, tender administration, contract management, public finance, audit, legal review, or procurement policy. You should be able to read tender documents and interpret basic procurement records. No programming is required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted bid analysis and digital procurement dashboards receive operational application treatment rather than technical engineering depth.
